status_effects.explanation: His fidelity to his own stated principles, even at real social cost, earns modest narrator approval relative to the Guermantes women's hypocrisy.
His abrupt abandonment of newly made bourgeois acquaintances casts him as fickle and self-interested.
Despite her superior formal rank, she is easily managed and denied her wish while feeling flattered, revealing her practical subordination to the Guermantes couple.

appraisal_events.evidence: le point de vue que défendait Saint-Loup quand il vivait avec Rachel... comportait – quelque horreur qu'il inspirât dans la famille – moins de mensonge que celui des demoiselles Guermantes en général... Saint-Loup agissait, au contraire, conformément à ses théories, ce qui faisait dire qu'il était dans une mauvaise voie.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator credits Saint-Loup with greater honesty and consistency between principle and conduct than the Guermantes women, even though this same consistency earns him social condemnation as being on a 'bad path.'

appraisal_events.evidence: aux quelques bourgeois intimes qu'elle avait conviés et auxquels le prince des Laumes mit alors des cartes avant de « couper le câble » dès l'année suivante.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator notes that the prince des Laumes made a show of connecting with his wife's bourgeois guests only to sever ties with them within a year, portraying him as opportunistic and socially fickle.

appraisal_events.evidence: La princesse de Parme, naïvement persuadée que le duc de Guermantes ne transmettrait pas sa demande à la duchesse et désolée de n'avoir pu obtenir l'invitation que désirait Mme de Souvré, était d'autant plus flattée d'être une des habituées d'un salon si peu accessible.
appraisal_events.explanation: The duke's self-serving, evasive speech leaves the princess deceived about his true intentions and unable to obtain what she wanted, yet she feels flattered rather than slighted, marking her as socially naive despite her formally superior rank.
